changelog.changes:
* Kids profile behind a PIN (TV interface): own tabs, bookmarks, history and sign-ins, site filters
* Custom DNS: DNS-over-HTTPS servers (Cloudflare, Google, AdGuard, Quad9, DNS.SB or your own)
* Clear browsing data of each profile from the settings or a hotkey
* New cursor setting: act as a mouse or a finger
* Channel +/- keys of remotes page up and down; new hotkey to toggle direct navigation
* "+" in the empty places of home page bookmarks adds a bookmark
* The whole app runs in one process: faster switching to incognito mode, less memory used
* WebView version: incognito mode and the kids profile need WebView 119 or newer
* Bugfixes and minor UI improvements

* Bugfixes and minor UI improvements
* Updated: default user-agent, cursor behavior, adblocker popup and windows blocking

* Major redesign
* GeckoView based version extracted to separate app variant
* Cursor behavior improvements
* Mobile/Desktop view for pages
* New ad blocker optimized for TV
* Resumable downloads, custom downloads folder
* Export and import bookmarks, bookmark folders
* Embedded optimized video player
* Support for HTTP proxy
* New languages support
* Integrated Qwant and selected as default search engine for several regions
* Updated dependencies
* Target latest Android versions
* Bugfixes, optimizations, many other UI improvements
* v3.0.x: multiple usability and bug fixes
* Several bugfixes (handling physical keyboards, page preview rendering)
